_about: The real-dataset corpus the engine and the analyst loop are tested on (tools/run_corpus.py). Each remote file is downloaded on demand into .corpus/ (gitignored: nothing here is published with the site) and checked against its sha256; a file whose bytes changed upstream fails loudly instead of silently testing something else. 'kind' is the data shape the file stands for, which the story templates and the benchmark group by. 'expect' holds what a good analyst must find, scored by tools/run_corpus.py --score.
